executedChecks.scope: Pure comparison: undeclared writes, sibling-area writes, declared writes not observed, unknown for deleted, renamed, binary, symlink, submodule and unsupported, case-folded matching, not-observed with the two closed reasons, unattributed writers unknown by default and excluded only by a named declared exemption rule, shared tree attributing nothing, 64 versus 65 changed paths and 512 versus 513 per-unit paths truncated with a recorded total, hostile names escaped; every output validated by the receipt schema. check-ownership run against temporary Git repositories (worktrees, commits, shared tree, untracked, symlink and binary files): a worktree changing between the two observations, a busy index lock, an unobservable or foreign source, an existing or symlinked output path, an output inside the repository, a missing base and over-bound input are refused with a code from command-error.schema.json, exit status 2, no result object and no file; the receipt is created with mode 0600 and carries no file content. Hazard notice: built from a receipt and from a pre-flight block; instruction fields byte-identical across seven adversarial strings and every text-exclusion sample; each exclusion class and a trailing line feed rejected by the schema unless escaped; validUntil shape, unique units, closed members; the reader rejects expired, superseded, stale-epoch and impossible-date notices and agrees with the schema on mutations; the repository-text pattern is byte-identical in the hazard and receipt schemas.

outcome: check-ownership observes committed or quiesced sources twice through the bounded Git helpers in-process, refuses every unstable, busy, unobservable, over-bound, malformed or existing-output condition with a closed error code and writes a receipt only to a new private file; the comparison never attributes an unattributed writer to a unit and never reports not-observed, unknown or a truncation as clean; the hazard notice carries an epoch, expiry and supersede link and only escaped, bounded repository strings in labelled data fields.
limits: Offline synthetic fixtures and temporary Git repositories. Class 1-syntactic: exact paths at the snapshot, no reads, no hunk or semantic effects. A busy lock is detected as a Git index.lock in a source worktree; other writers are caught only if they change the snapshot between the two observations. The notice builder and reader are library functions (no command emits a notice yet). The receipt truncations bound was raised from 64 to 192 entries so that 32 units with every list cut still validate. Hazard kinds derived from a pre-flight block are a fixed mapping; write-write conflicts remain the analyzer's. agent_braid/cli.py gains one dispatch condition and is deliberately not an input. No host, Claude Code, G1, speed, safety or independent-review claim.
